1.0.0: Initial release on the Gorgias REST API with API key (Basic auth) authentication: tickets (create, get, find, update, delete, add tags), ticket messages (customer message, internal note, email reply), customers (create, get, find, update, delete), users, views and tags pickers, Make API Call, webhook triggers for new tickets, updated tickets and new ticket messages, and a polling trigger for new customers.
1.0.1: New Ticket, Updated Ticket and New Ticket Message ignore webhook calls without the secret their Gorgias HTTP integration sends (answered with 403), so a forged request to the webhook URL can no longer make them emit a ticket. Restart running flows with these triggers: integrations registered by 1.0.0 have no secret.
